standard.summary: 同时保留在 GPU 的 block 数。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: How many blocks stay on the GPU at once.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 同时保留在 GPU 的 block 数。默认 4；16G 以下可降到 3。slots=6 在 16G@1024 易 OOM。

advanced_en.principle: Number of blocks kept on the GPU at once. Default 4; below 16G you can drop to 3. slots=6 OOMs easily at 16G@1024.
